scope: Read-only supplementary tooling review; no browser started, no application files edited and no deployment triggered.

workflow.findings: Requests the existing configured Pages main/root build with the repository-scoped Actions token; runs no checkout, source code, third-party action, data refresh or branch mutation. The repository path is quoted and no dispatch payload is evaluated as shell code.
workflow.completionQualification: A successful API request queues a build; it does not prove publication. The Pages build/deploy result and actual hosted content must still be verified.

refreshDiff.findings: Every recursive JSON type, dictionary key set, list length and factual scalar is checked. Exclusions are enumerated provenance/retrieval/hash scalar paths, not entire data subtrees. Incoming JSON bytes must equal the requested Git objects. The full application runtime file set and 181 non-data hashes are independently unchanged.
refreshDiff.limitation: compare-refresh.py itself compares hashes of known frozen runtime paths; this review separately checks runtime file-set equality so added runtime files cannot go unnoticed in this release.

manualRefresh.findings: Requires the completed full hosted WebKit report and exact current runtime. Observes the native Playwright control click, manual checking event, explicit updated/unchanged success, aria-busy reset, real HTTP200/304 request and exact current source JSON/HTTP200 response SHA. Error/offline retention cannot pass; there are no source substitutions or forced update statuses.
manualRefresh.qualification: The reviewed companion deliberately requires a stable approved published snapshot; if a newer automatic snapshot arrives during the check, exact-byte assertions fail rather than silently accepting stale expectations. This review only checks implementation/syntax; parent runs the actual browser proof after the current hosted test finishes.
